infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Televo uses your microphone for voice and video calls.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Televo uses your camera for video calls.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Televo needs access to your photos so you can send them in chats.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Televo saves photos and videos you download from chats to your library.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Televo uses your contacts to find friends who already use Televo. Contacts are hashed before they are sent and are never stored in the clear.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Televo uses Face ID to unlock the app.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photos so you can send them in chats.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your contacts to find friends who are already here.
